derivation.claim: Deterministic fallback references derived from raw observations; not the published fitted GAMLSS growth standards
derivation.ageConversion: ageDays = ageYears * 365.25; assign to nearest 7-day centre
derivation.interpolation: Linear interpolation is permitted only between adjacent weekly centres no more than 7 days apart; larger gaps are unavailable data
derivation.quantiles: 25th, 50th and 75th percentiles using linear interpolation at (N - 1) * p; weights rounded to 0.001 kg
derivation.dogEligibility: 84-730 days; known F/M sex; positive weight; AV_BREED_WEIGHT >0 and <=40 kg; PREVENTIVE_CARE_VISIT=Y or HEALTHY_PET_DIAGNOSIS=Y; minimum 100 observations per sex/category/week bin
derivation.dogCategories: I <6.5 kg; II >=6.5 and <9 kg; III >=9 and <15 kg; IV >=15 and <30 kg; V >=30 and <=40 kg, based on AV_BREED_WEIGHT
derivation.kittenEligibility: DataSet=Modelling; 56-546 days (8-78 weeks); known F/M sex; positive weight; minimum 30 observations per sex/week bin
derivation.limitations: Cross-sectional empirical quartiles may contain repeated animals and selection effects. Fitted cat BCCG curves describe the source population and are not clinical standards or breed-specific evidence. Dog rows are not mapped to VBO breeds.
derivation.fittedCatRuntime: Generate weekly P9/P50/P91 points from docs/research/97/bccg-curves.csv; P2/P98 and BCCG parameters remain research-only
derivation.modelledBreedRuntime: Normalize the matching-sex fitted population P50 by its final 546-day value, multiply that shape by the adult breed lower/midpoint/upper range, and append the exact adult range at 730 days. This is a model, not observed breed growth data. For Maine Coon and Siberian the empirical day-0 mean±SD point is retained separately and ages 1-55 are deliberately unavailable.
